on PrintStudyGuide lock screen local tStack, tGroupName, tTop,tList,tSectionHTML global gSelectedOrientation put StudyGuideOutputGroupID into tGroupName put "appligroup cs control " before tGroupName if exists(stack "Appli_Player") = true then put "Appli_Player" into tStack else put "Appli" into tStack end if if exists(stack "Print Study Guide") = false then set the topLeft of the templateStack to 0,0 create stack "Print Study Guide" set the destroyStack of stack "Print Study Guide" to true // SET A STANDARD WIDTH THAT SCALES WELL TO PDF set the width of stack "Print Study Guide" to 2550 reset the templateStack end if copy group tGroupName of card "Playground" of stack tStack to stack "Print Study Guide" put "Print Study Guide" into tStack // 1. RESIZE GROUP AND HIDE SCROLLBAR set the vScrollbar of group tGroupName of card 1 of stack tStack to false set the width of group tGroupName of card 1 of stack tStack to the width of stack tStack set the topLeft of group tGroupName of card 1 of stack tStack to 0,0 put 20 into tTop put the childcontrolnames of group tGroupName of card 1 of stack tStack into tList repeat for each line xLine in tList if xline begins with "rectangle cs" then delete group xLine of of group tGroupName of card 1 of stack tStack end if end repeat delete group "section template" of stack tStack repeat with xSection = 1 to the number of groups in group tGroupName of card 1 of stack tStack local tTheSection put "section " & xSection into tTheSection if not exists(group tTheSection of group tGroupName of card 1 of stack tStack) then next repeat end if // 2. ALIGN SECTIONS TO THE NEWLY EXPANDED GROUP WIDTH set the width of group tTheSection of group tGroupName of card 1 of stack tStack to (the width of group tGroupName of card 1 of stack tStack - 40) set the width of graphic "bg" of group tTheSection of group tGroupName of card 1 of stack tStack to the width of group tTheSection of group tGroupName of card 1 of stack tStack set the width of field "text" of group tTheSection of group tGroupName of card 1 of stack tStack to (the width of graphic "bg" of group tTheSection of group tGroupName of card 1 of stack tStack - 20) put "

" into tSectionHTML put StudyGuideDisplay["sections"][xSection]["topic"] after tSectionHTML put "

" after tSectionHTML put StudyGuideDisplay["sections"][xSection]["text"] after tSectionHTML put "

" after tSectionHTML set the htmltext of field "text" of group tTheSection of group tGroupName of card 1 of stack tStack to tSectionHTML // HEIGHT CALCULATION set the height of field "text" of group tTheSection of group tGroupName of card 1 of stack tStack to the formattedHeight of field "text" of group tTheSection of group tGroupName of card 1 of stack tStack set the height of graphic "bg" of group tTheSection of group tGroupName of card 1 of stack tStack to (the height of field "text" of group tTheSection of group tGroupName of card 1 of stack tStack + 20) set the height of group tTheSection of group tGroupName of card 1 of stack tStack to the height of graphic "bg" of group tTheSection of group tGroupName of card 1 of stack tStack // POSITIONING set the left of group tTheSection of group tGroupName of card 1 of stack tStack to 20 set the top of group tTheSection of group tGroupName of card 1 of stack tStack to tTop set the topLeft of graphic "bg" of group tTheSection of group tGroupName of card 1 of stack tStack to the topLeft of group tTheSection of group tGroupName of card 1 of stack tStack set the loc of field "text" of group tTheSection of group tGroupName of card 1 of stack tStack to the loc of graphic "bg" of group tTheSection of group tGroupName of card 1 of stack tStack add (the height of group tTheSection of group tGroupName of card 1 of stack tStack + 15) to tTop end repeat // 3. EXPAND EVERYTHING TO SHOW THE FULL CARD set the height of group tGroupName of card 1 of stack tStack to tTop + 20 set the height of stack tStack to (the height of group tGroupName of card 1 of stack tStack + 20) set the printpaperorientation to gSelectedOrientation // MARGIN OF 36 POINTS = 0.5 INCHES set the printMargins to 36,36,36,36 set the printpapersize to 2550,3300 open printing to pdf studyGuidePDF // THIS COMMAND PRINTS THE CARD SCALED TO THE PAGE MARGINS print card 1 of stack tStack close printing delete stack tStack end PrintStudyGuide
